headline: IRM Energy reports a change in its company auditors
hook: Procedural leadership change in auditing team
summary: IRM Energy Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding a change in its auditors. No financial impact or reasons for the change were detailed in the filing. Such routine corporate governance updates do not affect core operational performance. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note the administrative update without altering investment theses.
why_it_matters: Routine auditor change has no bearing on share price.

headline: IRM Energy submits annual general meeting voting results
summary: IRM Energy Limited has submitted its exchange voting results and the consolidated scrutinizer's report following its 11th Annual General Meeting. Shareholders voted on resolutions presented during the meeting. These regulatory filings are routine compliance procedures for listed companies. Retail investors holding shares can review the passed resolutions on the exchange portals.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance update with no immediate financial impact.
